subject.title: Workboard: improve stacked-card readability and human-approval visibility

question: Should Workboard represent human-action-needed cards as a first-class UI state, a prominent label convention, a configurable display rule, or some combination of those?
rationale: The code can support several narrow implementations, but choosing the semantic source and whether to add plugin config changes the product contract and future compatibility surface.

options.title: UI-local human-action state
options.body: Add a built-in Workboard affordance and summary for human-action-needed cards, derived from maintainer-approved card metadata or status without adding plugin config first.

options.title: Configurable display rules
options.body: Coordinate this issue with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/93053 and add explicit plugin-owned display configuration for field visibility and prominent labels.

options.title: Keep labels/manual convention only
options.body: Document the current blocked/label workaround and close or narrow this request if maintainers do not want new Workboard UX semantics now.

recommendation.title: UI-local human-action state
recommendation.body: Add a built-in Workboard affordance and summary for human-action-needed cards, derived from maintainer-approved card metadata or status without adding plugin config first.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete introduced the Workboard surface and is the strongest available owner for deciding whether this belongs as built-in UX or plugin config.
